terminal_coverage.note: Every E0-E9 failure/unknown path resolves to a terminal boundary or an explicitly bounded retry.

loops.budget: each compatible RUN slot at most once; S001 packet size=1

bounded_retry_coverage.generic_workflow_note: shared/workflow/v1/workflow.js permits reusable NEEDS_REPAIR cycles without its own numeric budget; this canary does not mislabel that generic product workflow as a bounded worker-loop. The RUN graph itself is finite.

cuts.minimum_human_action: provide exact human acceptance evidence for a candidate
cuts.machine_parallel_work: candidate inspection/verification may continue; promotion may not

cuts.minimum_human_action: none beyond prior acceptance; machine must carry exact acceptance id in transition request
cuts.machine_parallel_work: may prepare request; may not mutate CURRENT directly

human_absence_coverage.finding: Candidate artifacts can be produced, verified, returned, reallocated and closed without human routing. Promotion to HUMAN_ACCEPTED remains a legitimate human authority cut.

proposal.test: A deterministic generator emits canonical node/edge IDs and a fixture test compares emitted graph.json to executable source-derived expectations. CI fails on missing decision outcomes, unbounded RUN loops, or authority-cut removal.
proposal.drift_rule: Flow is rebuilt from executable contracts; hand-edited graph bytes are candidate output only and never authority.
